evidence_quotes.O: Not expecting anything stellar or amazing--and I won't even start comparing these to my audiophile quality cans.
evidence_quotes.C: I kinda had to replace the Earhugger headphones because...ok, I'll say it, I stepped on them.
evidence_quotes.E: Okay, headphones are a pain in the a$$! Trust me, you need to go through thousands to find the right ones. Let's get on with the review!
evidence_quotes.A: Since most of the reviews on these have been positive, might as well drop my very quick, negative review into the mix.
evidence_quotes.N: Only in five months the player kept freezing and I'm ending up reinstalling the firmware every three weeks.
